title: Ecomerate - stock research platform powered by AI in free private beta
author: ecomerate
selftext:
Hey guys,

I created Ecomerate, a financial intelligence type platform for researching stocks and ETFs.

I made it because my research workflow was too boring and tiring. I was up until midnight too many days to adjust my portfolio just right because I wasn't really sure on my thesis on certain stocks after big events.

It's in private beta. If anyone wants to try it through any stocks they have in mind just comment or DM me. You can also apply, and use the product for free.

Thanks!
